newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent firmer Monday based on market orders at 1017 EDT, traders said.

Prices settled weaker Thursday amid technically driven trade that accelerated once benchmark December fell through its downside target of 76.10 cents a lb. The most-active month closed down 0.89 cent at 75.80 cents after trading from 76.60 to 75.61 cents. The rest slid 0.92 to 0.65 cent.
An estimated 10,000 lots changed hands on the day.
Traders pegged nearby support at 75.40 cents followed by 75.00 cents for December delivery.
NYCE said one notice was issued today, bringing the total to date to 768 notices.
